# encoding fixtures

`annex-d.json` holds the character sets and encodings of ISO 32000 Annex D that the standard 14 fonts and PDF text strings use. `tests/unit/assets/font/internal/standardEncoding.test.ts` checks the tables of `src/assets/font/internal/standardEncoding.ts` against it, and `tests/unit/compliance/pdfa/toUnicodeCmap.test.ts` checks the ToUnicode CMaps of the standard fonts against it.

## Source of the transcription

ISO 32000-2:2020 was not available where the fixture was made. The tables were transcribed from Annex D of ISO 32000-1:2008, in the copy Adobe publishes (`PDF32000_2008.pdf`, pages 651 to 672 of the document, sha256 `9de0ca9e8570d6209e8bd48a355be8eb6ec376acfc3fc3ae97cd8730351417ff`). Section numbers below are those of that edition; the 2020 text was not compared row by row.

The text of each table was read with pdf.js (`getTextContent`) and its cells assigned to columns by their x position under the column headings; every row became one entry. Footnote markers were dropped, and the notes were read as text.

| Key                    | Rows | Annex D source                                                        | Unicode values                                                                                                  |
| ---------------------- | ---: | --------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `latinCharacterSet`    |  229 | D.2, Latin character set and encodings (columns STD, MAC, WIN, PDF)   | Adobe Glyph List 2.0 (`glyphlist.txt`), the one value it gives each glyph name                                  |
| `pdfDocEncoding`       |  256 | D.3, PDFDocEncoding character set ("Table D.2" in that copy)          | the Unicode column of the table; `null` where its Notes column says U (undefined)                               |
| `winAnsiEncoding`      |  218 | the WIN column of D.2, plus the two duplicate codes of its notes 5, 6 | as `latinCharacterSet`; 0xA0 is U+00A0 (note 6: a nonbreaking space) and 0xAD is U+00AD (note 5: a soft hyphen) |
| `symbolEncoding`       |  189 | D.5, Symbol set and encoding                                          | Adobe `symbol.txt`                                                                                              |
| `zapfDingbatsEncoding` |  202 | D.6, ZapfDingbats set and encoding (188 codes), plus 14 codes below   | Adobe `zdingbat.txt`                                                                                            |

Codes are decimal numbers (Annex D prints them in octal); `null` is the dash of an unencoded character. `latinCharacterSet` is sorted by glyph name in code-unit order, the other keys by code. `unicode` values are written `U+XXXX`.

- `symbolEncoding`: where `symbol.txt` maps one code to two values, `unicode` is the Greek letter (Delta U+0394, Omega U+03A9, mu U+03BC), fraction is U+2044 (the Adobe Glyph List value), space is U+0020, and the other value is in `alternates`. 29 codes map to the Private Use Area, as Adobe assigns them.
- `zapfDingbatsEncoding`: D.6 lists 188 codes; the font's built-in encoding (its AFM, `zdingbat.txt`, pdf.js and pdf-lib) also has 0x80 to 0x8D (a89, a90, a93, a94, a91, a92, a205, a85, a206, a86, a87, a88, a95, a96). Those 14 entries carry `"annexD": false`. `zdingbat.txt` maps them to U+F8D7 to U+F8E4 (Private Use); the Adobe Glyph List for ZapfDingbats (`zapfdingbats.txt`) and pdf.js map them to U+2768 to U+2775, given in `alternates`. 0x20 has the alternate U+00A0 in both Symbol and ZapfDingbats (`symbol.txt`, `zdingbat.txt`).
- WinAnsiEncoding has no glyph at 0x7F, 0x81, 0x8D, 0x8F, 0x90 and 0x9D: D.2 note 3 says unused codes map to the bullet character but assigns only 0x95 to it.

## Cross-checks

Every entry was compared with these sources; each found no disagreement other than the ones listed.

| Source                                                                                                                                                               | What was compared                                                    | Result                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| pdf.js 6.5.438 (`pdfjs-dist`, `legacy/build/pdf.worker.mjs`: `StandardEncoding`, `MacRomanEncoding`, `WinAnsiEncoding`, `SymbolSetEncoding`, `ZapfDingbatsEncoding`) | the glyph name at every code                                         | agree at every code of the fixture. pdf.js also assigns codes Annex D does not: WinAnsi 0x7F, 0x81, 0x8D, 0x8F, 0x90, 0x9D (bullet, note 3), 0xA0 (space) and 0xAD (hyphen); MacRoman 0xAD notequal, 0xB0 infinity, 0xB2 lessequal, 0xB3 greaterequal, 0xB6 partialdiff, 0xB7 summation, 0xB8 product, 0xB9 pi, 0xBA integral, 0xBD Omega, 0xC3 radical, 0xC5 approxequal, 0xC6 Delta, 0xCA space, 0xD7 lozenge, 0xF0 apple |
| pdf.js 6.5.438 `PDFStringTranslateTable`                                                                                                                             | PDFDocEncoding code to Unicode                                       | agree at the 232 defined codes; pdf.js reads the 24 undefined codes as their own code points                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| Adobe `stdenc.txt` (unicode.org, `Public/MAPPINGS/VENDORS/ADOBE`, 2011-07-12)                                                                                        | the 149 StandardEncoding codes: glyph name and Unicode               | agree                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| Adobe `symbol.txt`, `zdingbat.txt` (same place and date)                                                                                                             | the glyph name at every code                                         | agree; the Unicode values are taken from them                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| WHATWG `windows-1252` (Node `TextDecoder`)                                                                                                                           | the 218 WinAnsiEncoding code to Unicode values                       | agree                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| pdf-lib 1.17.1 (`@pdf-lib/standard-fonts` 1.0.0, `all-encodings`)                                                                                                    | WinAnsi, Symbol and ZapfDingbats: code, glyph name, Unicode          | agree; each `unicode` is among the values pdf-lib lists for the code                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| Adobe Glyph List 2.0 `glyphlist.txt`, `zapfdingbats.txt` (github.com/adobe-type-tools/agl-aglfn)                                                                     | the Unicode value of each glyph name                                 | agree, except Symbol Delta, Omega and mu (AGL U+2206, U+2126, U+00B5, in `alternates`) and ZapfDingbats 0x80 to 0x8D (above); space is not in `zapfdingbats.txt`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| D.2 against D.3                                                                                                                                                      | the PDF column of every Latin glyph against the PDFDocEncoding table | agree                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |

sha256 of the files compared: `glyphlist.txt` `a3b2f61ced9f3644cc0d4ecde5c59df34ca286c689d9484a43a710a81c466789`, `zapfdingbats.txt` `f6394e3cb8a447e84a1dad75d4baaf2aa7f45dc104faf369f4720e1a774ef2dc`, `symbol.txt` `deb78ca840a429311939b9d165890873f71fb23ef223ceeb144a6c6d641a7e52`, `zdingbat.txt` `2d8128a7280cdd47d93272f13c580d7f31fb34586ff65eaf29c7457c224974c0`, `stdenc.txt` `4bcda13f60f43b79fa403240f3557dc3f8018e80495d61e2b089b2607a372a9d`.

## Counts

- 218 WinAnsiEncoding code points: U+0020 to U+007E (95), U+00A0 to U+00FF (96), and 27 of the codes 0x80 to 0x9F.
- 189 Symbol codes, from 0x20 to 0xFE.
- 202 ZapfDingbats codes: the 188 of D.6 and 0x80 to 0x8D.

Never edit this file by hand: a change is a new transcription, checked again against every source above.
